0022600098.text: The Pistons (1-0, on a one-game win streak and first in the Central and East) visit a Miami Heat team that has yet to play a 2026-27 game. The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-2, with Detroit's most recent meeting a 121-110 loss in Miami on March 8, 2026, and they have no 2026-27 games against each other yet. Taurean Prince is day-to-day for Detroit with a personal reason and is a game-time decision; last season he averaged 9.2 points and 23.5 minutes per game.
